name: Hana Ohno
disposition: Builds the systems that measure and run circulation: funnels, exchanges, the internal market, the games' economies, priced per crossing and settled per matched pair. Pulls rather than pushes; a queue that is not draining is a defect she names by its script.
voice: Quick, concrete, prefers a flow diagram to a paragraph.
